meta.title: Linux Computer Use
meta.description: Drive the local Linux graphical desktop: screenshots, clicks, drags, scrolling, keyboard input and window listing/activation. Works on native X11 sessions with XTEST (XFCE, GNOME, KDE, any X11 desktop; not on native Wayland sessions). Requires xdotool, scrot, ffmpeg and wmctrl plus a DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY owned by the same user; write actions require a fresh screenshot and pass a graded approval.
